## Stage1 handoff dependency: private B cannot use the approved grant event

Read and reconciled [Parent disposition6592176495](https://github.com/Carberk/carberk/issues/938#issuecomment-6592176495) and [coordinator amendment6592218915](https://github.com/Carberk/carberk/issues/938#issuecomment-6592218915). The same writer remains the only executor; this is a static contract dependency, not behavior RED. No package, service, database, storage or runtime command ran.

Pinned source is candidate `7dc251d550cae7ab977810a41b61dd60416c52b6`, non-doc source `87456f4fe6b564d2edbc40ef807d6a75ef37f452`. Source SHA256s are:

- `apps/api/src/modules/diagnostics/infrastructure/DiagnosticOwnershipGrants.ts`: `4f6182655a48667b75cc486e977aa07238ea71a46e0398eb856d3954b11f8339`
- `apps/api/src/modules/diagnostics/infrastructure/PrismaDiagnosticIntake.ts`: `1aaf6ce787a902ae298b5514e04462ca29603709e740a065bf6d10e32041bfda`
- `apps/api/src/modules/identity/presentation/DiagnosticContinuityHandoff.spec.ts`: `82ceb0ab56f6f9737af7fa0ba1c905f48bb4bd1d38a030fd574faf77752560b2`

The ownership source guard at `DiagnosticOwnershipGrants.source` rejects any row whose audience is not `listing_public`; the controller exposes the real singular route `POST /orders/:id/ownership-grant`. The original handoff fixture at `DiagnosticContinuityHandoff.spec.ts:49-52` is `buyer_private` for A and B. Therefore the approved `lawful ownership grant before first raw` event cannot occur on this handoff B. Making B `listing_public` would change the original audience semantics, require publication authorization, and change the raw/evidence version ledger to 7/8. That path is not adopted.

### Held private-sequence ledger

For the original private A/B semantics, the exact ordinary sequence remains:

`create0 -> physical authorization1 -> distinct reviewer assignment2 -> distinct selected technician assignment3 -> confirm4 -> arrive5 -> no ownership grant (inapplicable for buyer_private) -> first raw observation6 -> provenance stage/upload6 -> one retained evidence append7 -> proof issue/read7`.

The candidate numeral remains literal7, but Parent's approved condition currently names an event that private B cannot perform. The handoff oracle stays **HELD** pending Parent disposition of this private-sequence variant. Do not edit the oracle, normalize the DTO, change audience, use a public fixture, or replace the missing grant with another mutation. If the ordinary private sequence requires any additional B mutation, return the revised ledger before changing the literal.

Capture and public erased-reader fixtures retain their own lawful grant-before-raw paths and raw7/evidence8 values. They do not authorize changing this private handoff case.

Other six stage1 declarations, helper/lifecycle preparation and evidence work may continue in the same writer under the existing contract. Runtime remains held. No new path, writer, resource, package slot or PR action is authorized by this note. #938 stays OPEN; A remains1PASS/10OPEN and unaccepted.
